verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable from Cloudflare's developer docs domain, and the docs describe the Realtime SFU as an HTTPS API. However, nothing shows that this spec covers the Realtime/SFU endpoints rather than being a general Cloudflare spec. Missing for 10: confirmation that Realtime SFU/TURN/RealtimeKit endpoints are included in the spec, a product-specific spec download page, independent or hands-on corroboration of spec usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Use the Realtime SFU API to control which endpoints publish or receive audio, video, and data.
Use standard HTTPS APIs and WebRTC from browsers, embedded firmware, native applications, and servers.
